cases.description: Writes to independent properties both commit.
Conflicting writes use the configured reject policy.
Stable priority resolves a write conflict independent of input iteration order.
A write/remove conflict is detected and recorded.
A retired item cannot also receive a successful property write.
Retirement cannot leave an active relation with a retired endpoint.
Duplicate active or retired identifiers cannot be reused.
A failed batch leaves the source configuration unchanged.
New items are not eligible for proposals from their creation boundary.
Permuting proposal input order does not alter deterministic output.
Same manifest and random roots reproduce the same reference result.
Reading or serializing state cannot mutate the source configuration.
